title: Luna Electrical System Live Operations V1.1
status: REFERENCE DESIGN — not procurement, not certified electrical engineering

fields.activeSource: 'utility' | 'generator' | 'inverter' | 'mixed' | 'none' — only utility/generator/none are ever emitted given current topology; mixed is reserved for the ATS changeover window; inverter is never emitted (see inverterRole)
fields.inverter: { on, batteryPct } | null — informational only, never a supply source

buildingPowerState.inverterRole: LUNA-B1-ELECTRICAL-INV-01 is surfaced for information (on/battery_pct) only. Its canonical state (a simple independent on/off toggle, parented to MDB-01, not wired into recomputePowerNetwork()'s cascade) does not support treating it as a building supply source — doing so would fabricate a role it doesn't have.

utilityFailure: Main distribution de-energized (momentary, no valid source yet)
utilityRestoration: ATS transfer initiated (TRANSFERRING) + Generator cooldown started (parallel)
generatorFailureDuringOutage: Generator faults while it is the live source
auto-start guarded against retry loop by the fault flag

newFields.note: break-before-make changeover window, managed by sequenceAtsTransfer()

newFunctions.name: sequenceAtsTransfer(newSource)
newFunctions.note: real ~1s changeover, mirrors sequenceGeneratorPhase()'s existing believable-timing precedent

eventLog.pubSub: reuses the existing provider notify()/subscribe() mechanism — no second event system

controlBoard.sharedShellChange: SystemControlBoard gained an optional headerContent?: ReactNode prop, rendered between the title row and tab selector — generic, building-agnostic, unused by Elevators/Water (no regression)

oyiChanges.newMatcher: matchBuildingPower — resolves asset-less building-power phrases to real anchors (GRID-01 for general, GEN-01 for causal 'why')
extendedMatchers: matchQuery (space-block: 'is Apartment 6A powered', 'what source is L06 using')
matchShowRoute (broadened power-phrase detection; 'active power path' default target; fixed a pre-existing system-dropping bug in its unresolved fallback)
newExplainFunctions: explainBuildingPower(power) in lunaExplain.ts — the one canonical building-power narrative, ref-anchored at GRID-01 and GEN-01
targetPhrasesVerified: What is the building running on?
Show me the active power path.
Show me where the power is coming from.

physicalGeometryImprovements.change: single door -> two door leaves + handles with a visible seam (segmented switchgear panel look)
added a control/annunciator panel with a fault/running indicator lamp
both source lamps flicker together during the transitioning changeover window instead of one being solid-lit
new optional shape?: 'round'|'duct' prop; electrical riser alone renders as a rectangular busway cross-section; every other riser (water/drainage/fire/network) unchanged (prop defaults to 'round')

routeImprovements: B1_ELECTRICAL_PLANT_RUNS gained per-run sourceGate ('utility'|'generator'|'bus'); each cable run's flowing pulse now reflects whether that specific physical path is live right now, read directly from resolveBuildingPower().activeSource

referenceAssumptions.voltageV: 415 (three-phase LV reference figure, not a final spec)
referenceAssumptions.currentA: 118 (flat reference figure at nominal load_pct, not measured)
referenceAssumptions.generatorStartDelay: ~3s (believable reference timing, not a performance spec)

unresolvedDesignDecisions.DD08: Electrical supply and resilience — demand/diversity, utility intake/transformer need, voltage arrangement, standby duty, generator count/rating, fuel/exhaust, ATS sequence, BESS strategy and metering ownership. Not resolved by this phase.
unresolvedDesignDecisions.DD07: Cable containment/coordinated shaft final routing. Not resolved — the duct-shaped riser is a closer visual read, not a final containment spec.
unresolvedDesignDecisions.other: Real UPS/BESS-as-a-supply-source modeling and Solar remain entirely unresolved/future — neither was invented in this phase.
